title: Energy Churning: How to Avoid Address Flags and Handle Returning Customer Rules?
body:
Hi everyone,
I am completely new to churning. With the ongoing energy cost increases, I've been advised to churn between energy (electricity / gas) retailers to benefit from sign up credits, switching every 3 to 4 months (or as soon as the credit safely lands in my account).
I have a few questions for the experienced churners here:
1- How often can I switch back and forth to the same retailer? How long do you have to leave a service provider before you count as a new customer again to receive a sign up credit?
2- Will the automated system always strip the welcome credit if I churn back to a previous retailer after only 3 or 4 months?
3- Is there a chance my name or address will get flagged/blacklisted if I switch back and forth between the same two companies 2 or 3 times a year?
4- What is your personal churning strategy to keep costs low? How do you manage your rotation sequence to harvest credits safely without triggering system warnings?
Appreciate any advice or tips you can share!
